findings.evidence: grep: `TauCeti/Probability/Exchangeability/PathSpace/Law/Basic.lean:80:theorem map_reindex_prefixProj (ρ : Measure (ℕ → α)) (φ : ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ)`; `ContractableLaw.lean:92: rw [map_reindex_prefixProj] at hmap`; `exists_strictMono_nat_extending_fin_eventually_add` supplies `∀ i : Fin m, φ i.val = k i` (PermutationExtension.lean:50), which is what `hidx` needs.
findings.fix: Replace `hcomp` and the final `rw` with the combinator: `have hidx : (fun x : ℕ → α => fun i : Fin m => x (k i)) = fun x : ℕ → α => fun i : Fin m => x (φ i.val) := by funext x i; rw [hφ_eq]` then `rw [hidx, ← map_reindex_prefixProj, hmp.map_eq]`. This also makes the proof structurally identical to `map_prefixProj_of_strictMono`, so the two can optionally be factored through a shared `MeasurePreserving (reindex φ) ν ν → (∀ i : Fin m, φ i = k i) → ν.map (block k) = ν.map (prefixProj α m)`.
findings.issue: The proof re-derives `map_reindex_prefixProj` (TauCeti/Probability/Exchangeability/PathSpace/Law/Basic.lean:80, publicly reachable via ContractableLaw) by hand with `Measure.map_map (measurable_prefixProj m) hmp.measurable` plus the `hcomp` composition step. That lemma states exactly `(ν.map (fun x k => x (φ k))).map (prefixProj α n) = ν.map (fun x i => x (φ i.val))`, and the sibling `ContractableLaw.map_prefixProj_of_strictMono` (ContractableLaw.lean:92) already uses it for the unrestricted case.

summary: The two remaining declarations are genuinely new: neither Mathlib nor TauCeti has a named fixed-set restricted MeasurePreserving, and the restricted block/prefix map equality has no in-repo counterpart. One proof re-derives the in-repo combinator `map_reindex_prefixProj`.
